update_text: Bug fixes: hero swap, boss revive, smoother scrolling and no more cut-off screens. Update now!
title: MONSTER CARDS
message: New in 1.3.1: every enemy and boss now drops its own Monster Card! Duplicates level your cards up for permanent ATK, HP, Gold, XP and gear drop bonuses, and they're kept through Rebirth. Bosses and rivals drop rarer, stronger cards. Tap the Cards button on Home to see your collection. Thanks for playing!
